origin:
Aston Martin's racing heritage, even at the amateur level, is steeped in a legacy of aspiration and a relentless pursuit of speed. The team's modern amateur iteration emerged from the ashes of a gentlemen's racing club in the Cotswolds, initially a group of well-heeled enthusiasts who gathered to enjoy classic Aston Martin machinery on local circuits. Driven by a shared ambition to compete more seriously, a core group, spearheaded by the charismatic financier, Sir Reginald Hargrave, decided to formalize their efforts, establishing the 'Aston Martin Racing Cotswolds' in 2008.

The early years were a blend of passion and pragmatism. Hargrave's financial backing provided a crucial foundation, allowing the team to acquire a stable of contemporary GT racing cars. Pivotal moments included a surprise podium finish at the Silverstone 24 Hours in 2012 and securing sponsorship from a local luxury watchmaker, solidifying their position within the regional racing scene. While victories have been sporadic, the team's commitment to meticulous preparation and their unwavering dedication to the Aston Martin marque have earned them respect within the amateur racing community.
philosophy: Aston Martin Racing Cotswolds operates with a blend of old-school craftsmanship and modern technology. The team's racing philosophy centers around a deep respect for the machinery, emphasizing meticulous maintenance and incremental improvements rather than radical overhauls. The team culture fosters a collaborative environment where seasoned mechanics and young engineers work side-by-side, sharing knowledge and passion for the Aston Martin name. While victory is always the ultimate goal, the team also values sportsmanship and camaraderie.
achievements: Podium Finish at the Silverstone 24 Hours (2012)
Multiple Class Wins in the British GT Cup Series
Consistent Top 10 Finishes in Endurance Racing Events

teamPrincipal.name: Sir Reginald Hargrave
teamPrincipal.background: Sir Reginald is a successful financier and avid motorsport enthusiast. He brings a blend of business acumen and passion to the team, fostering a culture of excellence and dedication.

keyFigures.name: Geoffrey 'Geoff' Beaumont
keyFigures.description: Geoff is a seasoned mechanic with decades of experience working on Aston Martin machinery. He has an encyclopedic knowledge of the cars and a knack for diagnosing and resolving complex mechanical issues.

keyFigures.name: Eleanor Vance
keyFigures.description: Eleanor is a young and ambitious engineer who brings a data-driven approach to car setup and performance optimization. Her analytical skills have been instrumental in improving the team's competitiveness.

headquarters: Aston Martin Racing Cotswolds is based in a converted barn complex near Stow-on-the-Wold. The facilities are basic but well-maintained, featuring a workshop, engine dyno, and a small office space.
fanBase: The team enjoys a loyal following among Aston Martin enthusiasts and local racing fans. Their supporters appreciate the team's commitment to the marque and their unwavering pursuit of racing glory.
